description: Source Provenance and Verification Manifest for Hydrology, River Networks, and Watersheds

geometries.processing: Vector extraction from OSM way 70237216 starting at dam outlet (115.79 m from dam centroid), clipped to valid DEM domain, oriented downstream (West to East). Length: 51.73 km.
geometries.limitations: Crowdsourced vector alignment representing low-flow surface centerline; does not capture bankfull hydraulic width or seasonal bathymetry.

geometries.dataset: OpenStreetMap Hydrographic Ways in Study AOI
geometries.exact_source_or_api: Overpass API (https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter) query: way['waterway'='river'] in AOI bounding box
geometries.processing: All river reach features inside AOI bounding box including upstream Bhavani, Moyar tributary, and downstream reaches. Total length: 138.97 km.
geometries.limitations: Includes upstream reservoir inflows and major tributaries.

geometries.provider: WWF / HydroSHEDS (Lehner & Grill 2013) / Google Earth Engine
geometries.processing: Extracted watershed polygon intersecting Bhavanisagar Dam (11.47083 N, 77.11389 E). Records SUB_AREA = 161.8 km2, UP_AREA = 4257.7 km2, MAIN_BAS = 4120028760, NEXT_DOWN = 4121595720, PFAF_ID = 453804030300, ORDER = 2.
geometries.limitations: Provides regional upstream watershed context (~4,257.7 km2) draining Western Ghats and Nilgiris; maintained separate from bounded M1 DEM hydraulic domain.

geometries.provider: WWF / Grill et al. (2019) / Google Earth Engine
geometries.exact_source_or_api: Google Earth Engine Asset 'WWF/HydroSHEDS/v1/FreeFlowingRivers' (BAS_NAME: Cauvery, REACH_ID: 40222384)
geometries.processing: 1D river reach network attribute UPLAND_SKM = 4118.4 km2 for the Bhavanisagar reach.
geometries.limitations: Polyline reach representation; distinct from the 2D polygon watershed dataset HydroBASINS hybas_12.

geometries.dataset: JRC Global Surface Water Mapping Layers, v1.4
geometries.provider: European Commission Joint Research Centre (JRC) / Google Earth Engine
geometries.exact_source_or_api: Google Earth Engine Asset 'JRC/GSW1_4/GlobalSurfaceWater' (Bands: 'occurrence' >= 50% and 'seasonality' >= 10 months)
geometries.processing: Extracted multi_decadal_water_occurrence_ge_50 (area = 31.38 km2) and persistent_water_core_seasonality_ge_10 (area = 40.30 km2). Cleaned with shapely.validation.make_valid and projected to EPSG:32643.
geometries.limitations: Represents historical satellite water frequency extent over 1984-2021 Landsat archive; NOT legal boundary, FRL design boundary, or flood capacity limit.

geometries.exact_source_or_api: Computed from data/terrain/dem_projected.tif using Priority-Flood depression filling and gradient enforcement
geometries.processing: Priority-flood filling ensuring continuous downhill drainage towards domain boundaries. Resolves flat waterbodies and spillway routing.
geometries.limitations: Numerical conditioning to eliminate spurious raster depressions; does not account for subterranean engineered culverts.

geometries.dataset: D8 Flow Direction & Upstream Cell Accumulation Grids
geometries.processing: D8 gradient-enforced DAG flow routing and topological accumulation. Max accumulation: 1,271,792 cells (1144.61 km2).

geometries.exact_source_or_api: Computed from data/hydrology/flow_accumulation.tif thresholded at 1000 cells (~0.90 km2)
geometries.processing: Vectorized contiguous stream cells >= 1000 cells. Evaluated against verified Bhavani mainstem: median offset 43.2 m, 67.7% within 60 m, 90.4% within 100 m.
geometries.limitations: Synthetic channel lines derived strictly from topography.

geometries.exact_source_or_api: Snapped from dam reference coordinate (11.47083 N, 77.11389 E) to adjacent thalweg cell (11.470195 N, 77.113911 E)
geometries.processing: Snapped to cell satisfying accumulation >= 1000 stream threshold. Snap distance: 70.34 m (< 500 m tolerance). Accumulation: 401,407 cells (361.27 km2). valid_against_threshold = True.
geometries.limitations: Hydrologic routing cell on 30m grid, distinct from physical masonry dam centroid.

geometries.exact_source_or_api: D8 reverse routing from snapped pour point over data/hydrology/flow_direction.tif
geometries.processing: Local basin footprint = 361.27 km2. Evaluated boundary interactions: upstream flow enters from outside DEM boundary. Classified: catchment_truncated = True, local_catchment_validity = 'INVALID_FOR_TOTAL_UPSTREAM_AREA'.
geometries.limitations: Covers only local DEM domain; total 4,257.7 km2 upstream catchment is maintained in HydroBASINS Level 12.

geometries.exact_source_or_api: Sampled at 100m chainage stations along data/hydrology/bhavani_mainstem_downstream.gpkg over data/hydrology/dem_hydroconditioned.tif
geometries.processing: 518 sample stations over 51.70 km reach. Start elev: 267.66 m MSL (below FRL 280.42 m MSL, dist to dam: 115.79 m). End elev: 195.00 m MSL. Net fall: 72.66 m. Average slope: 1.405 m/km.
geometries.limitations: Sampled along 30m DEM surface; reflects water/sand bar elevations at DEM epoch.
